		(InputLoadLow -0.01)
		(InputLoadHigh 0.01)
		(OutputLoadLow )
		(OutputLoadHigh )
		(CheckLoad Both)
		(CheckIO Both)
		(CheckDir 1)
		(CheckAssert 1)
		(CheckOutput 1)
		(UnknownLoading 0)
		(PinShape Line)
		(DIFF_PAIR_PINS_POS )
		(DIFF_PAIR_PINS_NEG )
	)
